notes: Structure as living-room.json. placement uses the product-card enum; placement_detail names the surface. z = layer order bottom to top; shadow at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. plan_m in house coordinates, Z from the floor. envelope_cm = max envelope per variant; 3 variants within +-15%. frames = master frames where the product is visible by design. hotspot and zoom_frame after the shell render. fillers = unsold contents (Bible 1.5).

density.rule: Bible 1.6 S11: lean frame, minimum 11 is a floor; as many as the designer judges do not detract. Counted = every identifiable product: visible part >= 0.05% of the frame and (>= 50% visible or visible part >= 1% of the frame); a set counts once.

W0.note: curtains and rug count as deliberately cut textiles (4.7% and 4.1% of the frame); desk-organizer est. ~0.07%
